text:
Registered residential sales totaled 10,419 units valued at AED 27,337,275,204 over the last four weeks, representing a 4.4 percent decrease in volume compared to the previous period. Mortgage registrations were recorded separately at 3,890, while the off-plan share of transactions stood at 65.4 percent, down from 67.2 percent in the prior four weeks.

The median residential price per square foot declined to AED 1,676, a 1.9 percent drop from the previous four-week median of AED 1,709. Top performing areas by sales volume included Dubai South with 4,534 units and Down Town Jabal Ali with 2,523 units over the last twelve weeks. Notable projects driving activity include Azizi Venice 6 and AZIZI VENICE 14 in Dubai South, alongside RAW DISTRICT BY IMTIAZ R in Down Town Jabal Ali.

Rental activity showed 81,151 Ejari contracts with a renewal share of 50.5 percent. The median annual residential rent was AED 70,900. Estimated gross yields for flats were highest in Zaabeel First at 9.5 percent, followed by International City Ph 1 at 8.6 percent and Town Square at 7.0 percent.

Market momentum varied by community, with Al Yufrah 1 showing a 35.9 percent increase in median price per square foot over twelve weeks. Conversely, Palm Deira cooled with an 18.1 percent decline, and Palm Jumeirah fell 12.2 percent. The anomaly monitor flagged 1,027 sales in the last 60 days priced more than 35 percent away from comparable medians. Figures are based on registered DLD data and Ejari contracts, using medians and benchmark filters that exclude bulk deals, partial shares, and statistical outliers.

facts.ranking_rule: communities with at least 30 eligible sales in both 12-week windows; yields also need 30 rent contracts of the same property type
